entries.content: Get task details and understand review feedback
Read current ReferenceLink.svelte and reference utilities
Fix ReferenceLink fallback to show raw ref instead of shortened

toolResponse.stdout:
Normalize reference displays across web UI — show titles and consistent linking
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK2NNQ0MJY54DX9PYHP4N1EA
Type:      task
Status:    needs_work
Priority:  3
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  References to tasks, specs, plans, and sessions are displayed inconsistently across the web UI. Some views show raw ULID prefixes, some show slugs, some show titles. Create a shared ReferenceLink component that: (1) accepts a ref type (task/spec/plan/session) and ID, (2) resolves and displays the title when available with the slug/ULID as secondary, (3) links to the appropriate detail view, (4) handles @ prefix normalization. Use this component in SessionContextPanel task_ref, session history task_ref, task card spec_ref, dashboard active work, and any other cross-reference display.
Spec ref:  @ui-reference-display
Tags:      feature, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-06T22:53:12.084Z
Started:   2026-03-07T01:57:13.092Z

─── Spec Context ───
Consistent Reference Display
Type: feature
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  Shared ReferenceLink component for consistent display of cross-references (task, spec, plan, session) across all web UI views. Normalizes @ prefix, resolves titles, and links to detail views.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: A reference to a task, spec, plan, or session appears in any view
    When: The reference renders
    Then: A shared ReferenceLink component displays the resolved title (when available) with slug or short ULID as secondary text, links to the appropriate detail view, and normalizes @ prefix (no double @@). Falls back to raw ref display if resolution fails.

─── Notes ───
[2026-03-07T01:59:45.964Z] @claude:
Execution context:
- Background: References displayed inconsistently - some raw ULIDs, some slugs, some with @@ prefix. Need shared ReferenceLink component.
- Scope: Create ReferenceLink component in lib/components/, utility for ref normalization, replace 13+ reference displays across web UI
- Files to change: SessionContextPanel, TaskCard, TaskDetailModal, TaskList, ActiveFleetRow, ActiveInvocationRow, sessions/+page, dashboard +page
- Verification: npm test in root, visual check that all reference displays show title+slug and link to detail views
[2026-03-07T02:10:48.734Z] @claude:
Implementation complete. Created:
- lib/utils/reference.ts: normalizeRef(), shortRef(), refHref() utilities
- lib/components/ReferenceLink.svelte: shared component with title/short-ULID display, linking, @ normalization
- tests/reference.test.ts: 14 unit tests covering normalization, shortening, and URL generation

Replaced reference displays in 9 files (12 files total changed):
- SessionContextPanel: task_id and spec_context.spec_ref now use ReferenceLink (spec_ref now clickable)
- TaskCard, TaskDetailModal, TaskList: spec_ref uses ReferenceLink
- TaskDetailModal: depends_on, blocked_by (now clickable), plan_ref (now clickable), session_ref all use ReferenceLink
- ActiveFleetRow, ActiveInvocationRow: task_ref now uses ReferenceLink (invocation row now clickable)
- sessions/+page, dashboard: task_ref displays use ReferenceLink

All tests pass (3911 + 14 new). 2 pre-existing failures in codex tests unrelated.
[2026-03-07T02:16:18.553Z] Jacob Chapel:
Review findings: MUST-FIX 1) packages/web-ui/src/lib/components/ReferenceLink.svelte renders @{short} when title is unavailable (lines 57 and 69), which truncates refs to 8 chars; spec @ui-reference-display ac-1 requires fallback to raw ref display when resolution/title is unavailable. This also causes slug refs to lose identifying text (shortRef() in packages/web-ui/src/lib/utils/reference.ts always slices to 8). MUST-FIX 2) Regression gate failed: npm test exits 1 with failing tests: tests/cli-serve.test.ts (foreground Ctrl+C support expects exitCode 0 but got null) and tests/cli/session-start-format.test.ts (primer timeline test timeout at 30s). packages/web-ui npm test passes.
[2026-03-07T02:16:24.794Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 1] Review findings: Review issues: ReferenceLink fallback does not match @ui-reference-display ac-1 (raw ref fallback expected, but refs are shortened to 8 chars when unresolved/title-missing), and required regression command npm test failed (2 failing tests).
